meta.name: security-audit
meta.description: Deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, authentication, authorization, data protection, dependency vulnerabilities, and secrets scanning. Delegates to the Centinela (QA) agent.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码中的安全漏洞与配置风险
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在发布前发现并修复安全漏洞。
copy.tagline_en: Scan code for security vulnerabilities and configuration risks
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to find and fix security vulnerabilities before release.

howto.what: 对代码库进行深度安全审计，包括OWASP Top 10检查、硬编码秘密扫描、依赖漏洞审计、智能合约检查等，并生成报告交给开发代理。
howto.when: 在发布前、重大代码变更后、定期安全审查或添加新依赖时触发，也可通过命令随时执行。

say.text: 对项目做一次安全审计
say.note: 运行完整审计流程并生成报告。

say.text: 审计 src/payments/ 目录的安全性
say.note: 仅审计指定目录，结果更聚焦。

howto.what_en: Performs a deep security audit covering OWASP Top 10, hardcoded secrets scanning, dependency CVE checks, and smart contract review. Generates a report and hands off findings to the Dev agent.
howto.when_en: Triggered before a release, after significant code changes, during periodic reviews, or when adding new dependencies. Can also be invoked on demand via a command.

say_en.text: Run a security audit on the project
say_en.note: Executes full audit and produces report.
